Question: I read your answers regarding above topic and found that Donate any organ is Haram alothough to their relatives.. Then how its permessionable to donate blood to anyone or relatives ? please answer me with reference with Quraaan & Hadis Answer ID: 32999 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1167/1167/M=1432) One is allowed to donate blood in exigent and extreme states. This ruling has been compared with that of milk i.e. as it is lawful for a mother to breastfeed her child in the time of need, in the same way it is allowable to donate the blood at the time of extreme compulsion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
